data.gender_notes: Dahra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'd-h-r', meaning 'to give' or 'to be generous'. Dahra is a name of abundant and lavish meaning, symbolizing the giving nature of Allah (swt) and reminding us of His boundless blessings. The name Dahra carries the meaning “Plentiful, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dahra usually hope their child will grow to embody plentiful, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
